## Statute

Section 152(d)(2) Relationship (lines 160-177):

    (2) Relationship

    For purposes of paragraph (1)(A), an individual bears a relationship to the taxpayer described in this paragraph if the individual is any of the following with respect to the taxpayer:

        (A) A child or a descendant of a child.

        (B) A brother, sister, stepbrother, or stepsister.

        (C) The father or mother, or an ancestor of either.

        (D) A stepfather or stepmother.

        (E) A son or daughter of a brother or sister of the taxpayer.

        (F) A brother or sister of the father or mother of the taxpayer.

        (G) A son-in-law, daughter-in-law, father-in-law, mother-in-law, brother-in-law, or sister-in-law.

        (H) An individual (other than an individual who at any time during the taxable year was the spouse, determined without regard to section 7703, of the taxpayer) who, for the taxable year of the taxpayer, has the same principal place of abode as the taxpayer and is a member of the taxpayer's household.

## Reasoning

The claim states that Alice bears a relationship to Bob under section 152(d)(2)(H) for the year 2018.

The statute at section 152(d)(2)(H) (line 177) requires that an individual bears a relationship described in this paragraph if:
1. The individual was not the spouse of the taxpayer at any time during the taxable year ("other than an individual who at any time during the taxable year was the spouse, determined without regard to section 7703, of the taxpayer"), AND
2. The individual has the same principal place of abode as the taxpayer for the taxable year ("who, for the taxable year of the taxpayer, has the same principal place of abode as the taxpayer"), AND
3. The individual is a member of the taxpayer's household ("and is a member of the taxpayer's household").

Case facts:
- Alice and Bob started living together on April 15th, 2014 (given in facts)
- Alice and Bob are not married (given in facts)
- The taxable year in question is 2018 (given in the claim)

Applying the statute to the facts:

1. Spouse requirement: The facts state "Alice and Bob are not married." Therefore, Alice was not Bob's spouse at any time during the taxable year 2018. This condition is SATISFIED.

2. Same principal place of abode: The facts state Alice and Bob "started living together on April 15th, 2014." Since they started living together in 2014 and the question concerns the year 2018, Alice has the same principal place of abode as Bob for the taxable year 2018. This condition is SATISFIED.

3. Member of household: The facts state Alice and Bob "started living together on April 15th, 2014." Living together means Alice is a member of Bob's household. This condition is SATISFIED.

All three conditions of section 152(d)(2)(H) are satisfied. Therefore, Alice bears a relationship to Bob under section 152(d)(2)(H) for the year 2018.

## Answer
Answer: Entailment
